title: Encoding a Query String
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $b_0,[4m\ldots[0m,b_{n-1}$ be Boolean bits, and let $t,a,x$ be Boolean lists. The query string is the bit list $(b_0,[4m\ldots[0m,b_{n-1})$ followed by the code of $t$, two false bits, the code of $a$, two false bits, and $x$.
hypotheses_covered: A Boolean-valued function on the indices $0,\ldots,n-1$
